note: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico's credit card agreements, one per card, each read in full on 30 October 2026 as its card agreements page links them: Visa Cash Rewards, Visa PREMIA® Rewards, AAdvantage® Visa Signature Plus, JetBlue Mastercard, JetBlue Mastercard Eleva and Visa Cobalt Infinite, the six cards Popular's Virgin Islands site (popular.vi) offers, each issued by Banco Popular de Puerto Rico. Each card's purchase rate is 16.99% to 29.99% a year by creditworthiness (the Prime Rate plus a margin), written as that range; its cash advance rate 27.99% to 31.99%, written so. The cards that open at 1.99% a year for their first six months carry that as their introductory rate (Visa Cobalt Infinite and Visa Infinite have none); the 0% balance transfer offer isn't written, balance transfers not being modelled. Each card's annual fee is as its agreement states (none where it says $0). The cash advance and convenience check fee is 2% of each transaction, at least $2 and at most $10. The foreign transaction fee is 1% on the two Visa reward cards, 1.4% on the JetBlue Mastercard, and none on the others (written as 0). The minimum payment is 2% of the balance or the interest plus $10 or $29, whichever is higher (the whole balance when it's under $29): written as 2% with a $29 floor; the interest-plus-$10 alternative, the higher one when the month's interest and $10 together pass 2% of the balance, isn't modelled.The late fee is 'up to $40' (and never more than the minimum payment due) and the returned payment fee 'up to $10', each written at its stated top. The due date is at least 21 days after each statement closes, and purchases go without interest when the full balance is paid by it: no longest grace is stated, so none is written. The agreements state no penalty rate and no over-limit fee. For residents of the British Virgin Islands the agreements set the margin at approval without reference to creditworthiness, and don't state it; the agreements' ranges are taken. Popular is the one bank whose card terms in the British Virgin Islands could be read: CIBC Caribbean's schedule of charges for the territory isn't among those its site serves (its Turks and Caicos, Antigua, St Kitts and St Lucia schedules are), and nothing else was found. This file kept Popular's Visa Cash Rewards, read on 29 October 2026, and adds its terms in full and the other five cards. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) also added CIBC Caribbean, one of the region's largest banks, whose Bvi/Tortola schedule of charges for cards (effective september 2020, last updated july 2026) its site now serves (an earlier pass found it refused or not linked): read in full, its personal credit cards in US dollars (4), each with its annual fee for the primary card (none where the schedule gives 0.00 or Free; waived for the first year where the schedule says so), its yearly purchase rate, its cash advance rate and fee, its late payment, over-limit and returned cheque fees, the minimum payment where the schedule gives one, and its late payment rate as the penalty rate, as the earlier CIBC files do. Its business, corporate, commercial and Bizline cards aren't written, nor the replacement, statement, rush card, emergency payment and auto-payment charges, which a holder meets only by asking or by an auto-payment; the UWI cards are for the University of the West Indies' students, faculty and alumni, a condition the game doesn't check. It states no grace period or foreign transaction fee.
